title: afripharmagen-catalog: Curated Pharmacogenomic Data for Sub-Saharan African Populations
description: Machine-readable pharmacogenomic allele catalog and reproducible analyses for sub-Saharan African populations. Includes allele definitions, population frequencies with Wilson score confidence intervals, and concordance benchmarks against PharmCAT.
